statement: Projecting n AND gates linked by one even parity equation onto their 2n inputs requires (3^n−1)/2 clauses even in a conjunction of CNF and affine GF(2) equations over the visible inputs only.
hypotheses: n>=2; exact projection, conjunction of explicit clauses and affine equations, no auxiliary variables or other representation.
definitions: y_i=a_i AND b_i, sum y_i=0 in GF(2); projected relation has even number of pairs 11.
source_locators: PNP-B004; Davis-Putnam J ACM 7 (1960) doi:10.1145/321033.321034. Proof is self-contained.
proof_or_gap: The zero vector and all unit vectors belong to the relation, so its affine hull is full. A falsifying clause cube must force every pair AND output; maximal such cubes select an odd active subset and one zero in each inactive pair. Each has a unique private witness with exactly one zero per inactive pair. Count (3^n−1)/2.
implication_to_claim: Eliminates polynomial materialization for exact auxiliary-free CNF+XOR projection, not SAT decision complexity.
unproved_dependencies: Efficient representation and decision procedure that retains auxiliaries or uses nonlinear constraints; arbitrary-instance runtime.
adversarial_findings: A direct circuit is linear size. No lower bound for hybrid solvers that avoid materializing this projection.
